status: Requirements; revised native coupon STLs pending

coupons.basis: Exact revised inlet/return bends, self-supporting roofs, adjoining wall and selected print orientation
coupons.gate: Slice with zero internal support. No floating islands; test actual minimum clear path, removable debris and inspection access. A successful geometric probe alone does not pass the physical coupon.

coupons.basis: Exact revised native M16x1 female thread, hand-tight stop, seal seat and actual sensor nose
coupons.gate: Actual sensor assembles and releases by hand without cross-threading; retained engagement and selected seal compression meet the measured specification. Do not substitute a generic thread generated by this pipeline.

coupons.basis: Exact selected M2/M3 boss/pilot/floor sections in both candidate materials; variation specimens must be individually labelled
coupons.gate: Selected supplier inserts seat square at controlled depth without wall damage, hold the selected tightening torque and survive repeat assembly. Record brand/part number and pilot result; nominal generic CAD is not a supplier specification.

coupons.basis: Exact aperture lip, factory casing corner and retainer-contact section
coupons.gate: Real factory-cased display fits without force or glass load; retainer contacts the intended casing surface; removal path remains practical.

coupons.basis: Exact holder rail, capture gap and RCY/BEC disconnect access section
coupons.gate: Measured occupied holder installs, is captured without cell loading and disconnects by hand; no pinched wires.

coupons.basis: Exact revised PETG bezel, frame/bridge seating section, 0.60 mm board reference and purchased GCT receptacle
coupons.gate: Receptacle and plug seat without force; cartridge is removable; no PCB flex or solder-tab load failure in the agreed physical insertion test. Sealing qualification remains separate.

coupons.basis: Exact revised chamber mating land and selected gasket/retention section
coupons.gate: Measure printed flatness and actual compression at the selected screw torque; establish a repeatable leak test before sample use. No unselected seal is silently treated as passed.
